benefits.text:
hince Raw Glow Gel Tint is a gel tint that creates a plump, glossy, gemstone-clear Raw-Glow effect, helping lips look juicier, smoother and more lively. The thin, light glossy gel tint texture makes intensity easy to adjust and can be layered for more visible color while keeping its clarity. The moisturizing formula helps keep lips soft and smooth, helps reduce the feeling of dry, rough lips, and keeps the color fresh and bright, helping minimize dulling or oxidation after application.
1. The Raw-Glow texture creates a naturally plump, glossy, clear and juicy lip effect.
2. Soft lip color, easy to adjust in intensity, and can be layered for more visible color.
3. The moisturizing formula helps keep lips soft and smooth, suitable for everyday use or pairing with many different makeup looks.

Raw Glow Gel Tint is one of hince's standout tint lines, with numerous achievements recorded in brand materials. The line achieved 4 consecutive award wins, was recognized as No.1 Tint in the Glossy/Gel Tint category of the Glowpick Awards from 2024 1H to 2025 Year-End, and reached 4.55 million units sold cumulatively across both full-size and mini shades in the period Apr 1, 2024 – Jan 25, 2026. These achievements help reinforce Raw Glow Gel Tint's image as an iconic hince gel tint line, loved for its gemstone-like clear gloss, fresh bright colors and flexible everyday use.

The 2026 Chill Voyage Collection adds 2 new shades inspired by the feeling of a fresh, soft and clear summer: 37 Chilling Rose and 38 Chilling Mauve. Shade 37 Chilling Rose has a soft warm rose tone like summer sunshine, giving lips a fresh, warm and radiant feel while staying natural, suited to a sandy rose look, warm clean makeup or looks that need an easy-to-wear warm rose lip. Shade 38 Chilling Mauve has a soft cool mauve tone with a refreshing feel, helping lips look clear, soft and moodier than a basic pink, suited to cool tone makeup, a clean blue look or looks that need a light mauve lip that still looks juicy and glossy.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

howToUse.text: Apply directly to lips. After applying, wait about 10 seconds and minimize pressing your lips together so the jelly-like glow layer forms more clearly. If the product is hard to draw out, gently tap the tube against your palm, then rotate the applicator tip 360° around the inner wall of the container before use.

sellingPoints.text: Gemstone-clear Raw-Glow effect; lip color with easily adjustable intensity; moisturizing formula helps keep lips soft and smooth.

texture.text: Thin, lightweight glossy gel tint, crystal clear.

finish.text: Clear gloss / plump / natural nude.

claimDisclaimers.text: “Plump” is a makeup effect, not actual lip plumping. “Moisturizing/reducing dead skin” must not be interpreted as treating peeling lips.
